lines.text: The Grama Sevaka Office opens at 8:30. The queue outside starts at 7:00. The gap between these two facts is where most of the drama in this room lives.
Three people are ahead of you. One of them has been here since before sunrise. You know this because he told you. Twice.

lines.speaker: Nandadasa Mahaththaya
lines.text: NIC. ER-1 form. Fill everything. Both sides. You have a pen?
He stamps something. He does not explain what he stamped. He has never explained what he stamped. He will not start today.

lines.prompt: He has filled in half your form. You have a question.

choices.label: "Mahaththaya, why does the form need to go through three offices?" (Curiosity perk,  Karunasena only)
Say nothing and take the form.
